title: Sharpness of Hölder's inequality on the hypercube
statement:
Fix a dimension $n$ and Hölder conjugate exponents $p, q$ (so $p, q > 1$ and $	frac1p + 	frac1q = 1$). For a function $g : \{0,1\}^n 	o  br$ write $
orm{g}_r =  igl(\E igl[\,|g|^r\, igr] igr)^{1/r}$ for its $L^r$ norm under the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$. Then for every function $u : \{0,1\}^n 	o  br$ there exists a function $f : \{0,1\}^n 	o  br$ with $
orm{f}_p \le 1$ and $
orm{u}_q \le \langle f, uangle$, where $\langle f, uangle = \E[f\cdot u]$.
hypotheses_covered: p and q are Hölder conjugate exponents (1/p + 1/q = 1, p,q > 1)
u is an arbitrary Boolean function of arity n
replaced:
For H\"older conjugate exponents $(p, q)$ and any function $u$, there exists a function $f$ with
$\norm{f}_p \le 1$ and $\norm{u}_q \le \langle f, u\rangle$.
